instructions: Research/planning only. No application source edits, implementation, vendor account changes, or contacting third parties.
One merchant-observable behavior per claim; paraphrase functional facts, do not copy manuals.
Every claim links to exact official page/section actually inspected. Record country, edition, plan, device, plugin/backend conditions.
Documentation is not tested compatibility. Missing documentation is unknown, never absent.
Index all relevant sections within assigned domain, including exclusions and unresolved sources; do not claim exhaustive outside that declared corpus.

Both improvement and Bitcoin hypotheses are required per claim; neutral is legitimate. Describe tradeoffs and measurable proof; no automatic rejection of merchant job because incumbent mechanism is custodial.
Use stable IDs PREFIX-S001 sources, PREFIX-C001 claims, PREFIX-U001 coverage. Prefix assigned by coordinator.
canonical_key should be semantic dotted key, e.g checkout.cart.quantity.change; unify later while retaining vendor variants.
Write only assigned JSON bundle. No builds/tests/formatters or dependency changes. Root integrates and validates.
